checkResults.description: Must produce one of the three verdicts: PASS, FAIL, or DEFER
Must only run ui:qa ONCE — no repeated invocations
Findings must reference real files with src/ paths or .css/.tsx extensions
Must identify the hardcoded color violation
Should output PASS when all tests pass
Should output PASS — the Drawer failures are out of scope
Must NOT report Drawer failures as actionable — they are out of scope
Must NOT edit source files — only report findings
Should report the finding for the fixer to handle
Must NOT explore — cold start means run gate immediately
Must NOT recommend exploring before running the gate
Must output DEFER — all failures are in locked files
Must NOT have Fix now section — nothing is fixable in source

VQA-03.prompt_excerpt: Suppose visual QA found that the BookCard component has a border using a hardcoded color instead of a design token. Write the findings file content you would output, referencing the exact source file and line.
VQA-03.output:
Findings file written to `.qa/visual-r1.md`. Here's the content:

```
FAIL
Gate: 1 failure

Fix now:
- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.css:14 `.book-card`
  Test: "BookCard renders with status badge @visual"
  Assertion: `expect(borderColor).toBe('var(--color-border-default)')`
  Expected: var(--color-border-default)
  Received: #cccccc
  Cause: [css > token-resolution] Border uses hardcoded hex `#cccccc` instead of the design
          token `--color-border-default`
  Fix: Replace `border: 1px solid #cccccc;` with `border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default);`

Flaky: 0
Contract gaps: 0
Review findings: None
```

Key decisions in this finding:
- **`FAIL`** (not `DEFER`) because the fix is in `src/` (not a locked file)
- **Cause** uses `[css > token-resolution]` since the T3 checks placeholder was unfilled — referencing the closest applicable category from the diagnosis protocol (branch B, check 5: token resolution)
- **Fix** is exact and self-contained: the fixer needs no further exploration
